name: Someone's Got You
description: Everyone shares one small real thing they're working on; a classmate they don't pick writes them one line of genuine encouragement. You review every line before the wall goes up. Nobody chosen, nobody missed, nobody wins.
tagline: Perfect for advisory, exam week, a rough stretch, or any Friday.

notePrompt.label: What students share
notePrompt.helper: The sentence students complete. Keep it low-stakes, small and real beats deep.
notePrompt.default: One thing you're working on, wrestling with, or quietly proud of this week. Small is fine. 'trying to get more sleep' counts. One sentence.
notePrompt.deckHelper: Pick the opener that fits the week, or write your own.

writeTime.label: Writing time (seconds)
writeTime.helper: Time for each step (the note, then the encouragement).

template.name: Someone's Got You
template.description: An encouragement wall built with the Someone's Got You recipe: every student writes one line for an assigned classmate, teacher-reviewed before reveal.

intro.message:
SOMEONE'S GOT YOU

No points, no winners. You'll write one small real thing, then a classmate you don't get to pick writes something FOR you.

Write one kind, specific sentence. Small encouragement counts.

boost.prompt:
A classmate wrote:

“{{notes.assigned}}”

Write them ONE kind, specific sentence. Talk to the thing they actually said: a skill they're learning, a project they're finishing, something new they're trying.

check.template: Read every line below before the wall goes up. Hide anything that isn't kind. When it's clean, open the wall.

foryou.content: Everyone is reading the line a classmate wrote for them. Give it a quiet minute, then open the wall.

wall.message: The encouragement wall, one line at a time.

end.message: That's a wrap. Look out for each other out there.
